source.name: Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
source.distribution: Public third-party mirror by ramSeraph/opendata; not a direct government download
source.scope: Every Mizoram village record in this LGD snapshot, including Rural and Urban categories. This is a village register, not a complete list of neighbourhoods, wards, Village Councils or sub-villages.
source.name_policy: Names, district assignments and categories are preserved as reported by LGD. Different LGD codes remain separate even when names match.
